PROP-e5782b58-asm-007.text: Bearer token for STEM Bot API calls must not be logged or exposed in client responses.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-007.assertion: STEM_BOT_API_TOKEN not in logs, error messages, or client-visible responses

locations.note: STEM_BOT_API_BEARER_TOKEN is used in Authorization header (line 100) but not logged. Line 90 logs discord_uid only. Error handling at line 106 logs status code and response body but not the token.
Same pattern: token used in Authorization header (line 134), error logging at line 140 does not include the token.
Token used in Authorization header (line 165). Error body logged at line 173 — does not include token, only response body from external API.
